text:
incident-bot: PAGE: ilb-privatevpc-crossregion-routing - P1 - multiple private VPC customers reporting increased 5xxs and timeouts in EU region. Escalation: oncall-network.

oncall-network: on it, grabbing signal now. anyone seeing similar from control plane or GCP APIs?

alex: seeing elevated 502/503 spikes from our ILB frontend in eu-west1 -> backend connection failures. Cloud LB healthchecks are flapping.

maria: telemetry: control-plane API to GCP (route-propagation) showing 429s from GCP API with high error bursts around 2146001000-2146001100. also auth token refresh errors intermittently.

jin: confirming: we have a concurrent surge of observability egress (agent -> thirdparty ingest) retries from privatevpc hosts causing ephemeral connection exhaustion on our egress proxies. that lines up with increased connection timeouts to GCP controlplane endpoints.

alex: Customer impact: API calls to private deployments are seeing increased latency and intermittent failures for customers with cross-region failover enabled. Some latency-sensitive customers report request timeouts ~10-20s.

support-liz: I’m triaging incoming customer tickets — 3 customers flagged as P1-impact. notifying account teams now.

oncall-network: immediate mitigations: 1) reduce observability agent egress from privatevpc eu hosts, 2) apply routing fallback for critical routes to use us-west1 (temporary), 3) throttle internal control-plane API clients to GCP to back off. applying in that order.

maria: I can disable verbose debug telemetry for privatevpc eu agents and flip off a subset of facets (traces/log streams) via the org config now. doing it in a rolling way to avoid a big spike.

observability-bot: ACTION: disabling trace export for tag=privatevpc-eu in 3...2...1. result: ~60% reduction in outgoing connections from eu hosts observed in 60s.

jin: starting emergency route override: set smart-routing policy for affected customer groups to prefer us-west1 for control-plane operations. this is a config change in the control plane; it will take ~30-90s to propagate.

alex: applying rate limit on our internal GCP control-plane clients: set client-side concurrency to 8 and increase retry base backoff to 2s with jitter. pushing policy now.

oncall-network: good. monitoring healthcheck flaps. any sign of ILB still dropping nodes?

maria: healthcheck failures dropped 85% after reducing egress and the routing override started propagating. latency is trending down but still above normal for some customers.

support-liz: I updated the customer-facing status with a brief note: "We are investigating increased errors for Private VPC customers in EU regions; mitigation in progress. We’ll post updates every 30 minutes."

incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: mitigation in progress - partial recovery signs. next update at +30m or on significant change.

jin: root cause hypothesis so far: cascade of third-party ingest failures -> observability agents retry storm -> egress proxy saturation -> increased latency and 429s to GCP control-plane APIs -> ILB healthcheck flaps and cross-region routing fallback causing customer-facing errors.

alex: also saw auth provider returning 401s intermittently (token refresh path), likely due to token service rate-limiting from same proxy saturation. separate but related symptom.

maria: timeline note to include in postmortem: 2146001000 initial observability vendor incident (external) -> 2146001030 agent retries surge -> 2146001055 control-plane 429s -> 2146001105 healthcheck flaps -> 2146001130 mitigation actions started.

oncall-network: plan for next 60m: keep route override, keep observability traces off, leave client-side throttles, monitor. target: full recovery or stable degraded state. if token refresh 401s persist, we may need to rotate to a fallback token service.

support-liz: customers asking for ETA. recommend phrase: "mitigation underway, service partially recovered; ETA for full recovery is unknown, next update in 30 minutes."

observability-bot: METRIC: outgoing egress connections from privatevpc-eu hosts down 72% after change; control-plane 5xxs down 65%.

alex: preparing a short mitigation playbook for oncall handoff. will include commands used, config keys toggled, and rollback steps.

incident-bot: SCHEDULED HANDOFF: oncall-network -> next oncall at 2146004500 (in ~55min). please include a summary and outstanding actions.

maria: I'll stay for the handoff and help with runtime knobs.

jin: logging the emergency route override command here for postmortem: ```
# emergency override
PUT /v1/routing/policies/override
{
  "scope": "privatevpc-eu",
  "preferred_region": "us-west1",
  "ttl": 3600
}
```

alex: client throttle applied via config: `controlplane.client.max_concurrency=8` and `controlplane.client.backoff_base=2000ms`. revert guidance: set concurrency back to 32 and backoff_base 200ms after stable for 2 hours.

support-liz: logging customer contacts: ACME corp (high), FintechCo (med), Shopster (low). created incident channel in support.

oncall-network: if we see re-escalation or new 5xx spikes after rollback, we should coordinate with GCP support and the observability vendor. open a case with both now and paste case IDs into postmortem.

incident-bot: ACTION: created cases: gcp-case-80812, vendor-case-77290.

maria: next steps for post-incident: 1) timeline + logs (control plane, agent egress, proxy), 2) quantify customer impact (RPCs failed, duration, list), 3) stable configuration recommendation (egress QoS and hard caps), 4) runbook updates for privatevpc to include observability-agent circuit breaker defaults.

alex: handing off now to jin for monitoring and follow-ups. I'll post the playbook link in #postmortems after we stabilize.

jin: ack - I'll own until next oncall takes over. current status: mitigations holding, partial recovery, customers under active support.

incident-bot: INCIDENT NOTE: please attach all logs, config diffs, and messages to the postmortem. set severity to Sev1->Sev2 if stable for 1 hour.

support-liz: copied. I'll keep the customer status updated and collate tickets for the impact assessment.

maria: adding final: we should consider hard egress caps for privatevpc hosts and an agent-side circuit breaker to prevent external vendor outages causing internal control-plane degradation. adding to action items. :memo:

incident-bot: THREAD CLOSED (temporary) - ongoing watch by jin. reopen if new regressions.
